cards.title: Four Is Floor

cards.rules: Do an impression of someone here having sex. You both drink 3.

cards.title: Buffalo
cards.rules: It's gotta go.

cards.title: Little Green Man

cards.title: Question Master
cards.rules: Until your next turn: anyone who answers your question drinks 2.

cards.title: Ace Is Waterfall
cards.rules: Start a waterfall. Everyone drinks until the player before them stops.

cards.title: Two Is You
cards.rules: Give 2 to the person you'd least want to share a bed with. Point so it's personal.

cards.title: Three Is Me
cards.rules: Drink 3. The cards have seen your browser history.

cards.title: Eight Is Mate
cards.rules: Pick a mate until your next turn. When one of you drinks, both drink, holding hands.

cards.title: Dragon's Breath
cards.rules: Breathe on the person to your right. They rate it out of 10. Over 5: you drink 3.

cards.title: Potion of Courage
cards.rules: Drink as many as you want, then pick someone to drink that many.

cards.title: Dungeon Master
cards.rules: Until your next turn, you narrate in third person. Slip = drink 2.

cards.title: Prophecy
cards.rules: Predict who finishes their drink next. Right: give 3. Wrong: drink 3.

cards.title: Side Quest
cards.rules: Give the table a dare. Anyone who refuses drinks 2.

cards.title: Hostage Video

cards.title: Dramatic Reading
cards.rules: Your left neighbor picks one of your texts. Read it aloud like erotica. Refuse: drink 4.

cards.title: Search History

cards.title: Hall Pass
cards.rules: Name your celebrity hall pass. If anyone laughs, drink 3.

cards.title: Dating Profile
cards.rules: Your right neighbor pitches you as a dating profile. Hate it: drink 3. Love it: they do.

cards.title: Bad Kisser
cards.rules: Describe your worst kiss in detail. Anyone winces: give 3. Nobody winces: drink 3.

cards.title: Pickup Artist
cards.rules: Try your worst pickup line on someone. They laugh: give 3. They don't: drink 3.

cards.title: Drunk Dial
cards.rules: Call the third person in your recents and say "I know what you did." Chicken out: drink 4.

cards.title: Meg Ryan

cards.title: Confession Booth

cards.title: Wet Willy

cards.title: Useless Fact

cards.title: The Receipt
cards.rules: Read your last purchase aloud. Cringe? Drink 3.

cards.title: Gym Class
cards.rules: Do 10 jumping jacks or drink 3. Anyone caught watching too closely drinks 1.

cards.title: Debate Club
cards.rules: Defend an opinion nobody shares. Lose the vote: drink 3.

cards.title: Who Farted

cards.title: Phone Check
cards.rules: Everyone puts their phone face up on the table. First to buzz drinks 3 and reads it aloud.

cards.title: Screenshot

cards.title: Spicy Camera Roll

cards.title: Toilet Talk

cards.title: Ex Files

cards.title: Nipple Check

cards.rules: Drink 1 for every ex you still follow. The table may audit your phone.

cards.title: Bad Baby Names

cards.title: Ex-Cuses

cards.title: Cheap Beers
